name: Java
exports_detected: public methods and fields (including static, final, synchronized, generic)
description: ☕ Detects public types and members across classes, interfaces, enums, and records. Generics included.

detection_rules.title: Public type declarations
detection_rules.description: Matches public class, interface, enum, record, and annotation types. Handles abstract, final, sealed, and static modifiers.

detection_rules.title: Public methods and fields
detection_rules.description: Matches public members including static, final, synchronized, abstract, and native modifiers. Generic return types are supported.

detection_rules.title: Javadoc stripping
detection_rules.description: /** ... */ Javadoc blocks are stripped before matching to prevent false positives from documentation examples.
detection_rules.example_code:
/**
 * @param token the JWT token
 * public String example() — this is NOT captured
 */
public String validate(String token) {}  // this IS captured

## Purpose

Java auth service for the JVM platform.

## Public API

| Symbol | Kind | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `AuthService` | class | Main auth class |
| `Authenticator` | interface | Auth contract |
| `validate` | method | Validates a JWT token |
| `DEFAULT_TTL` | field | Default TTL in seconds |

## Change Log

| Date | Change |
|------|--------|
| 2026-01-01 | Initial |
caveats: private, protected, and package-private (no modifier) members are excluded.
Annotation processors that generate public classes at compile time are not detected.
Inner classes are captured if they have the public modifier.
Lambda expressions and anonymous classes are not captured.
